security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your password and account protection.
security.backupWarning: Backups created before changing your password stay protected by the old password and do not reflect this change. Create a fresh backup right after changing it.

offlineDelivery.title: Offline delivery
offlineDelivery.label: Use offline delivery
offlineDelivery.description: When a contact is offline or no direct/relay connection can be formed, your messages are stored encrypted on network nodes and delivered as soon as the contact comes back online. Nodes only ever see ciphertext (recipient, sender, size, timestamps) — no message text, history, keys or contact list; envelopes are kept for up to 24 hours, after which undelivered ones are dropped.
offlineDelivery.disabledNote: When turned off, this mechanism does not start on your device: messages are sent only over a live direct or relay connection, otherwise they wait in the outbox until connectivity is restored.

attachments.title: Incoming files
attachments.hint: Auto-receive only downloads and verifies files; nothing opens or plays on its own. A per-contact restriction (in the contact's profile) always wins over these.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.hint: Your password encrypts everything stored on this device. Changing it re-encrypts all local data under the new password.
changePassword.progressHint: Re-encrypting your local data with the new password. This can take a little while — please keep the app open.
changePassword.progressDanger: ⚠️ Do not close or force-quit the app until this finishes. Interrupting a password change may damage your profile.

duress.title: Self-destruct password
duress.hint: If this password is entered on the unlock screen, Veyra erases the local profile and opens a clean empty profile protected by that emergency password.
duress.warning: This is irreversible. Contacts, chats, messages, attachments and local keys protected by the current profile are removed from this device.
duress.backupWarning: Older backup files remain separate files. Delete or replace backups yourself if they should not preserve the old profile.
duress.progressHint: Checking the password and updating the hidden verifier.
duress.progressDanger: Keep the app open until this finishes.

network.fileLogHint: Mirrors the app log into rotated files (up to 48 MB) so an overnight run can be read even when the system log buffer has churned. Off by default; no message contents are ever logged.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap nodes
bootstrap.hint: Bootstrap nodes are used for discovery only. They never store your messages, contacts or keys.
bootstrap.addByAddressHint: Enter a node's address and tap Check. The peer id is read from the node itself, then you confirm and add it. Once added it spreads to your verified contacts automatically.
bootstrap.probeNotVeyraWarning: This peer answered but does not advertise the Veyra bootstrap protocol. Add it only if you trust this address.
bootstrap.probeFailed: Could not reach a node at that address.
bootstrap.groupOfficialHint: Embedded or signed by Veyra. Used automatically.
bootstrap.groupLearnedHint: Nodes you added manually or received from contacts.
bootstrap.learnedWarning: This bootstrap node was learned from another peer. It is not official. It may expose your IP address to that node if you connect.
bootstrap.bundleHint: Import signed catalogs and private bridge descriptors from a JSON bundle file or pasted QR-safe text. Preview the issuer Profile ID before import. Addresses stay summarized until you reveal them.
bootstrap.networkSummary: Public & user bootstrap entries: {{public}} · Private bridges: {{private}} · Connected peers: {{peers}}
bootstrap.groupPrivateBridgeHint: Imported from an access bundle; dialed before public defaults when connecting. Verify the issuer before relying on them.
bootstrap.privateBridgeWarning: Private bridge from a bundle — not an official default. The operator may observe connection metadata.
bootstrap.passportFetchWarning: The request goes to the operator's server ({{host}}); its hosting will see this device's IP address. The passport does not affect trust or routes.
bootstrap.passportSelfDeclared: Details are declared by the node operator; the network only verifies the node's signature.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.hint: Connect to the network through your own proxy server. While the proxy is off nothing changes.
proxy.failClosedHint: While the proxy is on, all internet traffic goes through it and only through it. If the proxy is unavailable the app honestly stays offline — nothing goes around it. The local network keeps working.
proxy.callsDisabledHint: Calls are unavailable in proxy mode: they would reveal your address around the proxy.
proxy.busyCall: The proxy cannot be changed during a call: it would drop every connection. End the call and try again.
proxy.addressHint: You can paste the whole line — the fields fill in themselves.

proxy.passwordKeepHint: Leave the field empty to keep the current password.
proxy.checkOkPing: The proxy works, answered in {{ms}} ms.
proxy.errUnreachable: The proxy does not respond. Check the address and port.
proxy.errAuth: The proxy rejected the username or password.
proxy.errDenied: The proxy refused to connect to the network node.
proxy.errTimeout: The proxy did not answer in time.
proxy.errProtocol: The proxy answered in an unexpected way — the type may be wrong.
proxy.errTargetTls: A secure connection could not be established through the proxy.
proxy.errNoTarget: Nothing to check the proxy against: no known network node.
proxy.downBody: Veyra stopped network activity — nothing will go around the proxy. Your messages are saved and will be sent when the connection is back.
